verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a public, versioned REST API (/api/v1/). It covers transactions, payments, cards, invoices, webhooks and treasury, with scoped API tokens, OAuth2, a sandbox, an interactive Try It reference, a public changelog with migration guides, an official Go SDK and an llms.txt index for agents. Independent probes confirm the docs and llms.txt are live, but the machine-readable OpenAPI spec is not publicly downloadable. Missing for 10: a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec, a written deprecation/sunset policy and official SDKs beyond Go.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Access your accounts, transaction histories, and make payments programmatically with the Mercury API
Pull balances, list transactions, and initiate ACH transfers — all through a single REST API
Issue scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions
Initiate payouts directly from your systems via Mercury's API across ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire.
Our Sandbox environment is designed to make it easy for you to test API calls in a safe, simulated version of Mercury — no real money involved.
The Mercury Go library provides convenient access to the Mercury REST API from applications written in Go
